basic_profile.bio: Avid D&D enthusiast and amateur game designer based in Oregon. I spend most of my evenings diving into tabletop RPG lore and mechanics, often crafting my own campaigns. When not tinkering with dice and character sheets, I work as a software developer. I'm single and live with my two cats, Luna and Sol. My online hours are typically from 7 PM to midnight PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been playing tabletop RPGs for over a decade. My programming skills come in handy when managing complex game mechanics or automating aspects of my campaigns. I am largely self-taught in game design, often reading forums and guides online.
